in_hebrew.name: דָּצֵי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word דָּצַח (datsach), meaning 'dew from God'. This name is not found in the Bible, but it could be a derivative of the biblical name 'Dathan' or 'Dadan', which mean 'dew' in Hebrew.

in_greek.name: Δάκειος
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word Δάκω (dakō), meaning 'to follow'. In the context of Christianity, it could be interpreted as a 'follower of Christ'.

in_latin.name: Daceus
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word 'dew' and the Latin prefix 'da', meaning 'god'. This name is not found in the Bible, but it could be a derivative of the biblical name 'Datus' or 'Datius', which are Latinized forms of the Hebrew names 'Dathan' or 'Dadan'.
